description: Reference for `duplicate-function-neg`: WITHOUT a defer, two `function g` declarations in one function body compile and the later one wins (f() = 2). §7.3.3 deliberately leaves duplicate `function` declarations alone; neither E-SCOPE-REDECLARE nor E-DEFER-DUPLICATE-FUNCTION fires.
rationale: §7.3.3: two function declarations of one name in one block are outside the redeclaration rule; §19.16.6 limits E-DEFER-DUPLICATE-FUNCTION to blocks that contain a defer.
